data.long_description:
Provident  is proud to present this 3 bedrooms + maid, fully furnished apartment in Damac Heights. Details are as follows:

property details:
Fully furnished
- Vacant
- 3 bedrooms + maid
- High floor
- Sea/Marina view
- Gym
- Swimming Pool
- 1 Covered Parking
- Well maintained
- Balcony.

DAMAC Heights, now known as DAMAC Residence, is a supertall residential skyscraper in Dubai Marina, Dubai, developed by DAMAC Properties. It is 335 meters (1,099 feet) tall, has 85 floors, and was completed in July 2018. Designed by Aedas, the tower offers residential apartments with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and the Palm Jumeirah.

Dubai Marina is one of the most popular neighbourhoods in Dubai, known for its high-rise skyline, vibrant lifestyle and scenic marina views. Designed around a 3 km man-made canal, it combines luxury residential towers with a lively mix of dining, entertainment and leisure options.
